reply.text:
A three-day acute cut is outside what I'll coach. How much to drop, how to dehydrate, and how to manage fluids and sodium is where people get hurt, and it needs a doctor or a sports dietitian who can look at your weight and your division. I also don't set diet or calorie numbers in chat.

What I can say in general is that the best cut is the one you don't need. If you're close to the limit, the gap should be small enough that you're not chasing it in the last 72 hours. For your next tournament, we can plan the weight well ahead of time and keep your training sharp in the meantime.

If you tell me what you need for the next three days, I can set up a light session to keep you moving without adding fatigue before you compete. Want one?
